usageNotes: Adds a single IP address, CIDR block, or alias to a named IPSet on an LXC container's firewall; the IPSet must already exist before calling this endpoint. Requires VM.Config.Network permission on the target container. The `nomatch` flag inverts the entry's match logic, useful for carving out exclusions within a broader allow/deny rule referencing the IPSet.

examples.summary: Add a trusted office CIDR to an existing 'trusted-hosts' IPSet on LXC 120

tips: The IPSet must be created first via the corresponding POST /ipset endpoint before entries can be added.
The 'cidr' field accepts a bare IP (e.g. '10.0.0.5'), a CIDR block (e.g. '10.0.0.0/24'), or an alias name prefixed with '+' if defined in the firewall alias list.
Setting 'nomatch' to true turns this entry into a negation — the IPSet rule will explicitly exclude this CIDR rather than match it.
Changes take effect immediately in the firewall rule evaluation; no container restart is needed.
IPSets are container-local; entries added here are not shared with the node-level or cluster-level firewall IPSets.
